_comment: Pterodactyl/Pelican egg for Puniemu (contributed by eliasderzocker). Clones the source, optionally fetches master data, then builds. Import via Panel > Admin > Nests > Import Egg.
name: Puniemu (Yo-kai Watch Puni Puni)
author: puniemu@example.com
description: Private server emulator for Yo-kai Watch Puni Puni, written in C# / .NET 8. Built from source at install time, with optional live master-data fetch from the real gameserver.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
set -e
apt-get update && apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends git python3 python3-pip

pip3 install --no-cache-dir --break-system-packages aiohttp requests pycryptodomex 2>/dev/null || \
    pip3 install --no-cache-dir aiohttp requests pycryptodomex

cd /mnt/server

REPO_URL="${PUNIEMU_REPO:-https://github.com/SuperTavor/puniemu.git}"
BRANCH="${PUNIEMU_BRANCH:-master}"

echo "Cloning ${REPO_URL} (${BRANCH})..."
git clone --branch "${BRANCH}" --depth 1 "${REPO_URL}" source
cd source

# --- Live master-data downloader (talks to the real gameserver.yw-p.com) ---
cat > sharedLogic.py << 'PYFILE_SHAREDLOGIC'
import hashlib
from base64 import urlsafe_b64encode, b64decode
from gzip import decompress
from Cryptodome.Util.Padding import unpad, pad
from Cryptodome.Cipher import AES

class NHN:
    KEY = bytes([0xa8, 0x65, 0xd7, 0xe5, 0xe2, 0x45, 0x8f, 0x8c, 0xe1, 0xb5, 0xec, 0xd0, 0x87, 0xe5, 0x45, 0x94])
    GAMESERVER = "https://gameserver.yw-p.com/"
    headers = {
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
        "Accept": "application/json",
        "Accept-Encoding": "identity",
        "Connection": "Keep-Alive",
        "User-Agent": "Dalvik/2.1.0 (Linux; U; Android 9; SM-G965N Build/QP1A.190711.020)"
    }

    @staticmethod
    def decrypt_res(input_text: str) -> str:
        input_text = input_text.strip().replace('-', '+').replace('_', '/')
        input_text += "==" if not input_text.endswith("==") else ""
        decrypted = unpad(AES.new(NHN.KEY, AES.MODE_ECB).decrypt(b64decode(input_text)), AES.block_size)[20:]
        return decompress(decrypted).decode("utf-8")

    @staticmethod
    def encrypt_req(to_encrypt: str) -> str:
        to_encrypt_bytes = to_encrypt.encode('utf-8')
        digest = NHN.calc_digest(to_encrypt_bytes)
        padded = pad(digest + to_encrypt_bytes, AES.block_size)
        encrypted = AES.new(NHN.KEY, AES.MODE_ECB).encrypt(padded)
        return urlsafe_b64encode(encrypted)

    @staticmethod
    def calc_digest(payload: bytes) -> bytes:
        SALT = b"0bk2kvtFE2"
        sha1 = hashlib.sha1()
        sha1.update(SALT + b' ' + payload)
        digest = sha1.digest()
        secondSha1 = hashlib.sha1()
        secondSha1.update(SALT + digest)
        return secondSha1.digest()
PYFILE_SHAREDLOGIC

cat > DataDownloader.py << 'PYFILE_DOWNLOADER'
import json
import os
import sys
import aiohttp
import asyncio
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlparse
from sharedLogic import NHN

DL_SRV = "https://resource.yw-p.com/eal"


async def download_file(session, data, download_directory, use_game_structure):
    if use_game_structure:
        path = data["folder"] + '/' + data['fname']
    else:
        path = urlparse(data["url"]).path.lstrip('/')
    file_path = os.path.join(download_directory, path)

    os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(file_path), exist_ok=True)

    async with session.get(data["url"]) as response:
        if response.status == 200:
            with open(file_path, 'wb') as f:
                f.write(await response.read())
            print(f"Downloaded: {file_path}")
        else:
            print(f"Failed ({response.status}): {data['url']}")


async def download_files(download_directory, urls, use_game_structure):
    async with aiohttp.ClientSession() as session:
        tasks = [download_file(session, url, download_directory, use_game_structure) for url in urls]
        await asyncio.gather(*tasks)


def get_installation_data(data, url):
    return [{"folder": x[2], "fname": x[1], "url": f"{url}/{x[5]}/{x[3]}/{x[1]}"}
            for x in [item.split('|') for item in data.split("*")]]


def gather_urls(game_version):
    data = NHN.encrypt_req(f'''{{
        "appVer": "{game_version}",
        "deviceId": "d-822a61c56b60d03dd373aab9826210e1",
        "level5UserId": "0",
        "osType": 2,
        "tableNames": "ywp_mst_version_resource",
        "userId": "0",
        "ywpToken": "0"
        }}''')
    md = requests.post(NHN.GAMESERVER + "getMaster.nhn", headers=NHN.headers, data=data).text
    parsed = json.loads(NHN.decrypt_res(md))["ywp_mst_version_resource"]
    return get_installation_data(parsed["tableData"], DL_SRV)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    # Non-interactive version: reads config from environment variables instead
    # of input(), so this can run inside an automated (e.g. Pterodactyl/Pelican
    # egg) install step.
    #
    #   PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION      required - the game version to request master
    #                             data for (e.g. "40030")
    #   PUNIEMU_RESOURCES_DIR     optional - where to write the files, default
    #                             "Resources" (relative to the current directory,
    #                             which should be the puniemu checkout root so
    #                             the files land next to Puniemu.csproj)
    #   PUNIEMU_USE_GAME_STRUCTURE  optional - "true"/"y" to use the game's own
    #                             folder/filename layout instead of the URL path,
    #                             default "false"

    game_version = os.environ.get("PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION", "").strip()
    if not game_version:
        print("PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION is not set - cannot query master data without a game version.", file=sys.stderr)
        sys.exit(1)

    download_directory = os.environ.get("PUNIEMU_RESOURCES_DIR", "Resources").strip()
    use_game_structure = os.environ.get("PUNIEMU_USE_GAME_STRUCTURE", "false").strip().lower() in ("1", "true", "y", "yes")

    print(f"Fetching master data for version {game_version} into '{download_directory}' (game structure: {use_game_structure})")
    asyncio.run(download_files(download_directory, gather_urls(game_version), use_game_structure))
    print("Done.")
PYFILE_DOWNLOADER

FETCH_LIVE_DATA="${PUNIEMU_FETCH_LIVE_DATA:-true}"
if [ "${FETCH_LIVE_DATA,,}" = "true" ] || [ "${FETCH_LIVE_DATA,,}" = "1" ] || [ "${FETCH_LIVE_DATA,,}" = "y" ]; then
    if [ -z "${PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION}" ]; then
        echo "PUNIEMU_FETCH_LIVE_DATA is enabled but PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION is empty - set it in the server's egg variables." >&2
        exit 1
    fi
    echo "Fetching live master data for game version ${PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION}..."
    PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION="${PUNIEMU_GAME_VERSION}" \
    PUNIEMU_RESOURCES_DIR="Resources" \
    PUNIEMU_USE_GAME_STRUCTURE="${PUNIEMU_USE_GAME_STRUCTURE:-false}" \
    python3 DataDownloader.py

    # Puniemu.csproj only embeds "Resources\*.txt" (non-recursive), but the
    # downloader writes files into subfolders (URL-path or game-structure
    # layout). Flatten everything one level up so it actually gets embedded.
    echo "Flattening downloaded resources into Resources/ so they match the non-recursive EmbeddedResource glob..."
    find Resources -mindepth 2 -type f -name '*.txt' -exec mv -n {} Resources/ \;
    find Resources -mindepth 1 -type d -empty -delete
else
    echo "Skipping live master-data download (PUNIEMU_FETCH_LIVE_DATA is not true). Assuming Resources/ is already populated by the repo."
fi

echo "Restoring and publishing..."
dotnet restore Puniemu.csproj
dotnet publish Puniemu.csproj -c Release -o /mnt/server

echo "Install complete. Built files are in /mnt/server (mounted as /home/container at runtime)."

variables.name: Puniemu Git Repository
variables.description: Git URL to clone and build at install time.

variables.name: Fetch Live Master Data
variables.description: If true, downloads current master data (items, Yo-kai, gacha, stages, ...) from the real gameserver at install time instead of relying on a static snapshot in the repo. The official servers are offline, so this only works against a mirror; leave false and upload Resources/ yourself.

variables.name: Game Version
variables.description: Game version string, used both for the live master-data download and as the app's own GameVersion setting (so InitHandler's version check matches without patching source).

variables.name: Use Game File Structure
variables.description: If true, saves downloaded resources using the game's own folder/filename layout instead of the URL path.

variables.name: Postgres Host
variables.description: Hostname or IP of your Postgres server.

variables.name: Postgres Database Name
variables.description: Name of the database Puniemu should use.

variables.name: Server Name
variables.description: Display name for the server (Puniemu's ServerName setting).

variables.name: Supabase Key (optional)
variables.description: Only needed if you use Supabase instead of Postgres. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: Supabase URL (optional)
variables.description: Only needed if you use Supabase instead of Postgres. Leave empty otherwise.

variables.name: Admin Token
variables.description: Enables the admin panel at /admin. Use a long random string.

variables.name: Language
variables.description: "en" translates the game data with the dictionaries in Translations/en.

variables.name: Public Server URL
variables.description: Public base URL of the server, e.g. https://puni.example.com
